name: Ca doi muoi hot
summary: Cá đối nổ muối hột is mullet buried in coarse salt and cooked by the heat of the salt as it pops. The flesh stays moist and tastes of coarse salt and lemongrass, then goes into rice paper with forest leaves.
howToEat: The fish is cooked in the salt, not over a grill. Take the flesh, roll it in rice paper with forest leaves.
seoTitle: Ca doi muoi hot — salt-cooked mullet in Can Gio
seoDescription: Cá đối nổ muối hột is mullet cooked in popping coarse salt, moist, with salt and lemongrass.
texture: The flesh does not dry out.
taste: Coarse salt and lemongrass, with the sweetness of the fish and the forest leaves.
